title: hugohe3/ppt-master
title_zh: PPT Master——人工智能可从任何文档生成原生PowerPoint

paragraphs.en: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He
paragraphs.zh: AI 能将文档或主题转化为真正原生的 PowerPoint 演示文稿——包含原生形状、切换和动画，按需生成有数据支撑的图表和表格，可根据演讲者备注生成音频旁白，并支持使用你自己的 .pptx 模板。 · 作者：Hugo He

paragraphs.en: Thanks to Kimi for sponsoring this project! Kimi K3 is the world's first open 3T-class model, featuring native vision and a 1-million-token context window. With PPT Master, K3 can understand source materials such as PDFs, DOCX files, and web pages, identify key points, structure the narrative, and generate a natively editable PPTX that you can continue refining in PowerPoint.
paragraphs.zh: 感谢 Kimi 赞助本项目！ Kimi K3 是全球首个开放的 3T 级模型，具备原生视觉能力和 100 万 token 的上下文窗口。 借助 PPT Master，K3 能够理解 PDF、DOCX 文件和网页等原始资料，识别要点、组织叙事结构，并生成可在 PowerPoint 中继续完善的原生可编辑 PPTX 文件。

paragraphs.en: Editable is already table stakes — what sets PPT Master apart is native depth. It hands you a real PowerPoint: slide masters, native shapes, data-backed charts and tables — not flat text boxes, and not a filled-in template. It also does more than lay slides out nicely — it reasons the argument into shape first, then designs; and that native depth keeps converging with PowerPoint itself , adding more of its native capabilities release after release. In form, it's a workflow that runs inside any agent-capable AI tool: hand the AI your topic or material, and it generates on your machine — your data stays local, no platform or model lock-in. How it works and where the limits are → Product Positioning .
paragraphs.zh: 「可编辑」早已是基本门槛——真正让 PPT Master 与众不同的是原生深度。 它交给你的是一份真正的 PowerPoint 文件：幻灯片母版、原生形状、基于数据的图表和表格——而不是扁平的文本框，也不是填好内容的模板。 它不只是把幻灯片排版得漂亮——它先对论证进行梳理成形，再进行设计；而且这种原生深度还在持续向 PowerPoint 本身看齐，一个版本接一个版本地增加更多原生能力。 在形式上，它是一个可以在任何具备智能体能力的 AI 工具中运行的工作流：把你的主题或材料交给 AI，它就会在你的机器上生成——你的数据保持本地，不锁定于任何平台或模型。 它的工作原理和局限性所在 → 产品定位。

paragraphs.en: Editable is now table stakes — the real question is how much of PowerPoint you actually get. PPT Master delivers PowerPoint's native object model itself, and in depth: native shapes and connectors with working adjustment handles, data-backed charts and tables on demand, and the full text / picture / fill / effect model — click any element and keep editing it as a native PowerPoint object; and through the template / structured route, it can hand you a deck with real slide masters and layouts ( p:sldMaster / p:sldLayout inheritance).
paragraphs.zh: 「可编辑」如今只是入场券——真正的问题是你在多大程度上真正获得了 PowerPoint 的能力。 PPT Master 交付的是 PowerPoint 原生对象模型本身，而且相当深入：原生形状与连接符带有可用的调节手柄、按需生成的基于数据的图表和表格，以及完整的文本／图片／填充／效果模型——点击任何元素都可以继续作为原生 PowerPoint 对象进行编辑；并且通过模板／结构化路线，它还能交付带有真实幻灯片母版和版式（p:sldMaster / p:sldLayout 继承关系）的演示文稿。

paragraphs.en: And that depth is a direction of travel, not a fixed checklist. PPT Master's north star is to keep converging with PowerPoint itself: an ongoing effort to build and integrate more of PowerPoint's native capabilities, release after release, closing the gap between what an AI can generate for you and what you could build by hand in PowerPoint. The PowerPoint ↔ SVG Mapping Guide is the honest, feature-by-feature record of how far that reaches today — and SmartArt is a deliberate omission, not a gap.
paragraphs.zh: 而这种深度是一个前进的方向，而不是一份固定的清单。 PPT Master 的北极星是与 PowerPoint 本身不断趋同：在一次次版本发布中，持续构建并集成更多 PowerPoint 的原生功能，缩小 AI 能为你生成的内容与你在 PowerPoint 中手工构建的内容之间的差距。 PowerPoint ↔ SVG 映射指南是对这一能力当前覆盖范围的诚实、逐项功能的记录——而 SmartArt 是有意为之的省略，并非能力缺口。

paragraphs.en: In form, it's a workflow (a "skill") that runs inside any agent-capable AI tool: tell it in chat — "make a deck from this PDF" — and it runs the workflow on your machine and exports a natively editable .pptx . No coding on your side; you do exactly three things — install Python, install an AI tool, drop in your material.
paragraphs.zh: 形式上，它是一个在任何具备智能体能力的 AI 工具中运行的工作流（即一种「技能」）：你在聊天中告诉它——「用这份 PDF 做一个演示文稿」——它就会在你的机器上运行该工作流，并导出原生可编辑的 .pptx 文件。 你无需编写任何代码；你只需做三件事——安装 Python，安装一个 AI 工具，放入你的素材。

paragraphs.en: Generating a new deck from source documents is the main pipeline, but not the only route. PPT Master can also distill reusable brand / style / layout / deck templates from your references, fill an existing .pptx with new content while preserving its design, and add native transitions, animations, and narration to a finished deck — each route with an explicit contract for what gets preserved. How to use each capability → Getting Started .
paragraphs.zh: 从源文档生成新演示文稿是主要流程，但并非唯一路径。 PPT Master 还可以从你的参考资料中提炼可复用的品牌 / 风格 / 版式 / 演示文稿模板，在保留现有 .pptx 设计的同时为其填充新内容，并为已完成的演示文稿添加原生切换、动画和旁白——每种路径都有明确约定，说明哪些内容会被保留。 如何使用各项功能 → 参见快速入门。

paragraphs.en: harness + model = agent — PPT Master only owns the workflow; the model sets the ceiling. Recommended: Kimi K3 (or Claude) with a large context window (~1M tokens) + AI image generation ( gpt-image-2 or Google gemini-nano-banana-2.1 ) ; other models can run the pipeline, with a quality gap.
paragraphs.zh: harness + 模型 = 智能体 —— PPT Master 只负责工作流，模型决定上限。 推荐：Kimi K3（或 Claude）配合大上下文窗口（约 100 万 tokens）+ AI 图像生成（gpt-image-2 或 Google gemini-nano-banana-2.1）；其他模型也能跑通流程，但存在质量差距。

paragraphs.en: And don't expect a finished, perfect deck in one shot. The tool's value is taking most of the tedious work off your plate; the polishing that's left is yours — a natively editable deck exists precisely so you can keep working on it, not a flat image you can't touch. The cheaper the model, the more there is to do; if results disappoint, upgrade the model first, then check your usage against Getting Started and the example projects .
paragraphs.zh: 并且不要指望一次就得到一份成品级、完美的幻灯片。 这个工具的价值在于帮你免去大部分繁琐工作；剩下的润色由你来完成——之所以生成原生可编辑的幻灯片，正是为了让你能继续加工，而不是给你一张无法修改的平面图片。 模型越便宜，需要自己做的事就越多；如果结果不理想，请先升级模型，再对照「入门指南」和示例项目检查你的用法。

paragraphs.en: I'm a finance professional (CPA · CPV · Consulting Engineer (Investment)) who regularly reviews and edits presentation decks. I wanted AI-generated slides to remain editable in PowerPoint, not flattened into images — so I built this.
paragraphs.zh: 我是一名金融专业人士（注册会计师 · 注册资产评估师 · 投资咨询工程师），经常审阅和编辑演示文稿。 我希望 AI 生成的幻灯片在 PowerPoint 中保持可编辑状态，而不是被压平成图片——所以我做了这个工具。

paragraphs.en: Knowing how to use Python and AI agents will matter more and more, and this project is also meant to show how far you can go with just those two things. There's a learning curve if you're starting cold, but it's the curve worth climbing — making a deck is just the excuse; what I'm really pushing is Python and agents.
paragraphs.zh: 懂得如何使用 Python 和智能体会越来越重要，这个项目也想展示仅凭这两样东西你能走多远。 如果你是零基础起步，会有一个学习曲线，但这是值得攀登的曲线——做一份演示文稿只是个借口，我真正想推动你学的是 Python 和智能体。

paragraphs.en: # macOS brew install python # Ubuntu / Debian sudo apt install python3 python3-pip Edge-case fallback — 99% of users don't need this Pandoc — only needed for legacy document formats: .doc , .odt , .rtf , .tex , .rst , .org , or .typ . .docx , .html , .epub , .ipynb are handled natively by Python — no pandoc required.
paragraphs.zh:
# macOS
brew install python

# Ubuntu / Debian
sudo apt install python3 python3-pip

边缘情况的后备方案——99% 的用户不需要这个

Pandoc — 仅在处理旧版文档格式时需要：.doc、.odt、.rtf、.tex、.rst、.org 或 .typ。

.docx、.html、.epub、.ipynb 由 Python 原生处理——无需 pandoc。

paragraphs.en: Option A — Git clone (recommended; requires Git installed): the preferred path, since a clone can pull the latest version at any time.
paragraphs.zh: 方案 A — Git 克隆（推荐；需安装 Git）：首选方式，因为克隆仓库可以随时拉取最新版本。

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/hugohe3/ppt-master.git cd ppt-master Then install dependencies:
paragraphs.zh: git clone https://github.com/hugohe3/ppt-master.git cd ppt-master 然后安装依赖：

paragraphs.en: pip install -r requirements.txt Option B — Download ZIP (no Git required; best for a quick trial): click Code → Download ZIP on the GitHub page , then unzip, and install dependencies with pip install -r requirements.txt . A ZIP has no Git history, so it can't git pull — see Updating Later. If that download is too large or fails, grab the skill-only package ppt-master-skill-*.zip (~56 MB, fully functional but without the bundled example decks) from the Releases page instead.
paragraphs.zh: pip install -r requirements.txt 方案 B — 下载 ZIP（无需 Git；最适合快速试用）：在 GitHub 页面上点击 Code → Download ZIP，然后解压，并用 pip install -r requirements.txt 安装依赖。 ZIP 包不含 Git 历史，因此无法 git pull — 参见「稍后更新」。 如果该下载包太大或下载失败，可以改为从 Releases 页面获取仅含技能的包 ppt-master-skill-*.zip（约 56 MB，功能完整，但不附带示例演示文稿）。

paragraphs.en: First, open the project folder in your agent: the goal is to point the AI at the ppt-master directory you unzipped / cloned in the previous step. paragraphs.en: Provide source materials (recommended): Place your PDF, DOCX, images, or other files in the projects/ directory, then tell the AI chat panel which files to use. The quickest way to get the path: right-click the file in your file manager or IDE sidebar → Copy Path (or Copy Relative Path ) and paste it directly into the chat.
paragraphs.zh: 提供源材料（推荐）：将你的 PDF、DOCX、图片或其他文件放在 projects/ 目录中，然后在 AI 聊天面板中告诉智能体要使用哪些文件。 获取路径最快的方法：在文件管理器或 IDE 侧边栏中右键点击该文件 → 复制路径（或复制相对路径），然后直接粘贴到聊天中。

paragraphs.en: You: Please create a PPT from projects/q3-report/sources/report.pdf Paste content directly: You can also paste text content straight into the chat window and the AI will generate a PPT from it.
paragraphs.zh: 你：请从 projects/q3-report/sources/report.pdf 创建一个 PPT。直接粘贴内容：你也可以将文本内容直接粘贴到聊天窗口中，AI 会据此生成 PPT。

paragraphs.en: You: Please turn the following into a PPT: [paste your content here...] By default—unless you explicitly request quick generation—the AI first confirms the design spec:
paragraphs.zh: 你：请将以下内容制作成 PPT：[在此粘贴你的内容……] 默认情况下——除非你明确要求快速生成——AI 会先确认设计规范：

paragraphs.en: AI: Sure. Let's confirm the design spec: [Template] B) Free design [Format] PPT 16:9 [Pages] 8-10 pages ... The AI handles everything — content analysis, visual design, SVG generation, and PPTX export.
paragraphs.zh: AI：好的。 让我们确认设计规范：[模板] B) 自由设计 [格式] PPT 16:9 [页数] 8-10 页…… AI 会处理一切——内容分析、视觉设计、SVG 生成以及 PPTX 导出。

sents.en: AI: Sure.
sents.zh: AI：好的。

sents.en: Let's confirm the design spec: [Template] B) Free design [Format] PPT 16:9 [Pages] 8-10 pages ...

sents.zh: AI 会处理一切——内容分析、视觉设计、SVG 生成以及 PPTX 导出。

paragraphs.en: Quick generation (skip the confirmation round trip): say so explicitly and the AI goes straight to authoring and export.
paragraphs.zh: 快速生成（跳过确认往返）：明确说明这一点，智能体将直接进入撰写和导出。

paragraphs.en: You: Quickly generate a 5-page deck from projects/q3-report/sources/report.pdf — no need to confirm with me Whatever you state explicitly is followed; whatever you leave unspecified the agent decides on its own instead of asking. It still converts sources, fills factual gaps, applies the shared visual baseline, and uses images/icons/native shapes/charts/tables/PowerPoint-native inline or block formulas as needed — it drops interaction and durable planning, not presentation capability. It is one-pass and non-resumable, and there is no svg_final/ preview. Full guide → Quick mode .
paragraphs.zh: 你：从 projects/q3-report/sources/report.pdf 快速生成一份 5 页的演示文稿——无需与我确认。凡是你明确说明的，智能体都会遵循；凡是你未指定的，智能体会自行决定，而不是向你询问。 它仍会转换源文件、填补事实空白、应用共享的视觉基线，并按需使用图片/图标/原生形状/图表/表格/PowerPoint 原生的行内或块级公式——它舍弃的是交互和持久化规划，而不是演示能力。 它是一次性完成且不可恢复的，也没有 svg_final/ 预览。 完整指南 → 快速模式。

sents.en: Full guide → Quick mode .

paragraphs.en: Output: the deck lands in exports/<name>_<timestamp>.pptx as natively editable DrawingML; the default flow also writes self-contained page previews to svg_final/ . Charts and tables ship as editable shapes by default; pass --native-charts-and-tables for data-backed PowerPoint Chart / Table objects with Edit Data , saved as a separate _native_charts_tables.pptx . Formulas compile to editable OMML for PowerPoint 2010+. Backups, notes, animation and narration switches, and the non-PowerPoint boundaries → FAQ .

paragraphs.en: Two paths for non-user images, mixable per image in the same deck:
paragraphs.zh: 非用户图片有两条路径，可在同一卡组中按图片混合使用：

paragraphs.en: A) AI generation — use the agent host's native image tool when available, or image_gen.py with IMAGE_BACKEND plus the provider's *_API_KEY . Host-native generation needs no separate provider image API key; ask the agent to use its own image tool. Run python3 skills/ppt-master/scripts/image_gen.py --list-backends for the configured-provider path. gpt-image-2 is currently the best default.
paragraphs.zh: A) AI 生成——若可用，优先使用智能体宿主的原生图像工具，否则使用 image_gen.py 并配置 IMAGE_BACKEND 以及相应服务商的 *_API_KEY。 宿主原生生成无需单独的服务商图像 API 密钥；让智能体使用其自带的图像工具即可。 运行 python3 skills/ppt-master/scripts/image_gen.py --list-backends 可查看已配置的服务商路径。gpt-image-2 是目前最佳默认选择。

paragraphs.en: mkdir -p ~ /.ppt-master cp /path/to/installed/ppt-master/.env.example ~ /.ppt-master/.env PPT Master reads the current process environment first, then the first .env found in this order: current working directory, skill directory (e.g. ~/.agents/skills/ppt-master/.env ), clone repo root, ~/.ppt-master/.env .
paragraphs.zh:
```bash
mkdir -p ~/.ppt-master
cp /path/to/installed/ppt-master/.env.example ~/.ppt-master/.env
```

PPT Master 首先读取当前进程环境，然后按以下顺序读取找到的第一个 .env 文件：当前工作目录、技能目录（例如 ~/.agents/skills/ppt-master/.env）、克隆仓库的根目录、~/.ppt-master/.env。
